We're moving forward with the Q3 capacity add-on we discussed last week — adding 200 dedicated seats to our Dedicated pool and increasing monthly RPS. Finance would like to consolidate the add-on onto a single PO that covers the remainder of the renewal term rather than issuing a bunch of small POs. Can Redwood: 

- Accept one consolidated PO for the term add-on (we'll reference the existing renewal contract number)
- Update the primary billing contact to Lydia Park (lydia.park@solstice.ai) for invoices going forward
- Provide a W9 or instructions on how to get your W9 on file so our AP team can process the consolidated PO

Also — Solstice prefers Net45 for renewals; can you confirm whether Redwood can invoice Net45 for this consolidated PO or whether we need to sign any additional paperwork?

I'll attach the preliminary request sheet for amounts. If it's easier, AP can send over a formal PO once we have the billing contact and W9 on file.

Thanks,

Hi David — thanks for the note and the request sheet. Welcome news on the expansion.

Short answers up front:
- We can accept a single consolidated PO for the add-on tied to your existing renewal contract.
- We can change the billing contact to Lydia Park once we receive confirmation from your AP or a signed PO that explicitly names her.
- We can provide our W9 immediately (attached) and our billing team will liaise with Solstice AP on the invoice schedule.
- Net45 is possible but will require a one-time billing term exception from our finance team for this renewal; I have looped in Marissa and Rishi to approve.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please have AP issue the consolidated PO to match the amounts in the attached request sheet and name Lydia Park as billing contact.
2) Attach the PO here and cc ap@redwood.com (or send through DocuSign); we'll update billing and queue the invoice.
3) Marissa — can you confirm whether we can approve Net45 for this renewal once we have the signed PO & W9? If there are any finance approvals needed, please advise timeline.

I've attached a sample invoice template so AP knows the fields we need.

Thanks,
